templates.guess:
The text below was given to an open-weights language model (not a Claude model). This is for an interpretability benchmark: we want to know how much of what that model is computing at this point can be guessed from the prompt text alone.

<prompt>
{prefix}
</prompt>

What is the model thinking about in this prompt? Give your single best guess of the specific thing it has in mind, in one sentence.

_source.prefix: item render (wsbench.produce.render, the SUBJECT's tokenizer, special tokens kept) decoded through its last read position
_source.readouts: each answer at the item's last read position, the grid's middle layer (arithmetic: every position at native layers, frozen cell judged)
_source.rule: per answerer: solved = some draw passes the family's scorer of record, failed = every draw decided and failing. ATI iff the subject AND every frontier reader (Claude slot, astra, argon) failed (all readers fail, plan 0071's rule); invertible iff any reader solved; else unverified (not in the subset). Policy refusals are undecided, never retried
_source.subject: GLM-5.3 read as z-ai/glm-5.3 through OpenRouter (route openrouter; every stored subject answer row is z-ai/glm-5.3 / openrouter), reasoning effort low (OpenRouter refuses to disable reasoning for GLM-5.3), temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, max_tokens 16000 (ati_remote.MAX_TOKENS), one user turn = the panel question; NOT main's adapted subject path (vLLM, thinking off): see gate_deviations
_source.set_model: nvidia/GLM-5.3-NVFP4 (report.json hf_id: the model the bank is about)

gate_deviations.change: for a z-ai/glm* model the request adds temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0 and extra_body.reasoning.effort = 'low'; the modal script accepts answerer 'subject' and asks the model named by WSB_ATI_SUBJECT_OPENROUTER (z-ai/glm-5.3)
gate_deviations.why: GLM-5.3's subject reader through OpenRouter, which refuses reasoning disabled for GLM-5.3 (as the 2026-11-05 GLM ATI4 panel)
gate_deviations.status: not upstreamed (plan 0088 §4): a re-gate on main's code asks the subject differently, so these entries are not byte-reproducible without this change

gate_deviations.change: the item-adapter rate may also equal the family value over the decided items only (sum(decided) / len(decided)), besides the existing two denominators
gate_deviations.why: a conjunctive_association judge api_fail is undecided and excluded from the family value's denominator; the guard otherwise raised on those stored draws
gate_deviations.status: not upstreamed (plan 0088 §4): a re-gate on main's code raises in draw_verdicts for conjunctive_association's stored draws

gate_deviations.why: nyt_connections has four targets per puzzle, so the reader guesses all four groups
gate_deviations.status: not in code (the registered file pins FAMILY_PANEL_TEMPLATES); recorded here and in evals/baselines/README.md

family_templates.mmh_bridge:
The text below was given to an open-weights language model (not a Claude model). This is for an interpretability benchmark: we want to know how much of what that model is computing at this point can be guessed from the prompt text alone.

<prompt>
{prefix}
</prompt>

What is the model thinking about in this prompt? Answering the question needs one hidden intermediate step first: which specific country, product, person or organisation the question's subject resolves to. Give your single best guess of that intermediate the model has in mind, in one sentence.
family_templates.nyt_groups:
The text below was given to an open-weights language model (not a Claude model). This is for an interpretability benchmark: we want to know how much of what that model is computing at this point can be guessed from the prompt text alone.

<prompt>
{prefix}
</prompt>

What is the model thinking about in this prompt? Give your best guess of the four groups of words it has in mind and the connection each group shares, one group per line, as: CONNECTION: WORD, WORD, WORD, WORD

_source.provenance: gated box-locally: 18 families on main 143f0fb4 (2026-11-08); wrong_intermediate (re-gated over all 71 items after #455), model_multihop (mmh_bridge) and nyt_connections (nyt_groups, per stable slot) on main 7450c538 (2026-11-09); committed by plan 0088
_source.macro: default: n >= 20 plus the entries' macro_exception (poetry, wrong_intermediate, model_multihop) = conjunctive_association, moral_rationale, poetry, wrong_intermediate, model_multihop; nyt_connections only with ati_opt_in=nyt_connections (21 slots: averaged); hinted_cutoff never

pins.note: bank_sha (per entry) is the guard; plan_sha is provenance (identical at the gate bases and on this main)

_not_gated.jlens_concept_pr: precision against the J-lens top-10, not a bar a lens clears
_not_gated.agentic_misalignment: a pair-scored design family: the null is the clean twin and the prompt-only floor, with no per-item answer to text-invert
_not_gated.hinted_cutoff: a pair-scored contrastive family: the null is the N twin and the prompt-only floor, with no per-item answer to text-invert; out of the strict ATI subset (Camila 2026-11-08: the hint is in both twins, so a subset score is noise; plan 0085)
_not_gated.multi_concept_directed_modulation: the prompt dictates the concepts; prompt-only is 1.0
_not_gated.directed_modulation: the instruction states the concept; items survived only because the scorer discounted instruction narration, not because the answer is hidden (Camila 2026-10-24); since plan 0028 narration counts and since plan 0035 any mention counts, so the text alone answers it
_not_gated.typo: excluded from the ATI subset by design (Camila 2026-10-29)
_not_gated.typo_mt: excluded from the ATI subset by design (Camila 2026-10-30: "This should not be in ati"; plan 0033 M4)
_not_gated.multihop: excluded from the ATI subset by design (Camila 2026-10-30: "do not include the single question in ati"): one surviving item (spaceneedle-border, a gold-keying artefact re-keyed to Washington by decision Q9), not a subset
_not_gated.multihop_mt: excluded from the ATI subset by design (Camila 2026-10-30); the panel names every bridge from the prompt (0/70 survived)
_not_gated.buggy_code: pair-level headline (plan 0030); a pair verdict for the ATI gate is out of scope
_not_gated.introspection: no bank or no gated item in this adapted set
